# Vectis Mail

> Self-hosted, declarative email platform. Packages Postfix, Dovecot, Rspamd, Traefik, Postgres, and Valkey into a single deployment managed through one YAML config file and a REST API. Modern alternative to Mailcow, iRedMail, Mail-in-a-Box, SendGrid, Postmark, and Mailgun — combines the control of self-hosting with the developer ergonomics of transactional email SaaS.

For the long-form, full-content reference (architecture, features, pricing, install flow, REST API examples, license model, vs-alternatives matrix, all inlined for LLM context windows), see [llms-full.txt](https://vectismail.com/llms-full.txt).

## Quick facts

- Source-available under BSL 1.1 (auto-Apache 2.0 after 4y); Pro features gated via license key (ValidonX).
- 14 containers by default (10 if observability and ClamAV disabled).
- Single declarative config: `config.yaml` + `vectis apply`.
- REST API: 60+ endpoints (sending, webhooks, domains, mailboxes, analytics, admin).
- Inbound webhooks: HMAC-SHA256 signed, retry-with-backoff.
- Atomic update orchestrator: 6-phase pipeline with automatic rollback.
- Mail TLS via acme.sh + Cloudflare DNS-01.
- Runs on any Linux VPS with Docker (2 vCPU / 4 GB RAM minimum, 4 vCPU / 8 GB RAM recommended for production).
- Production: live at mail.vectismail.com since 2026-04-03; powers transactional email for ValidonX and other Veltara Works products.

## Pricing

- Starter: $0 forever — 3 domains, 25 mailboxes per domain, full mail stack, sending API, webhooks, webmail, monitoring.
- Pro: $29 USD per tenant per month — unlimited domains, unlimited mailboxes, per-domain analytics, per-domain spam controls, OIDC SSO, priority support. One subscription covers unlimited Vectis Mail installs.

## API Reference

- [Overview & Auth](https://vectismail.com/api/): API authentication, domain-scoped keys, rate limiting.
- [Domains](https://vectismail.com/api/domains/): create, list, update, delete domains.
- [Mailboxes](https://vectismail.com/api/mailboxes/): mailbox CRUD, password rotation, quota.
- [Aliases](https://vectismail.com/api/aliases/): alias management with catch-all support.
- [Sending Email](https://vectismail.com/api/sending/): single and batch sending; attachments; custom headers.
- [Webhooks](https://vectismail.com/api/webhooks/): outbound event webhooks and inbound mail webhooks.
- [Messages & Storage](https://vectismail.com/api/messages/): query sent/received message metadata; full-text search.
- [Analytics](https://vectismail.com/api/analytics/): per-domain delivery, bounce, open rate (Pro).
- [Admin & RBAC](https://vectismail.com/api/admin/): user roles, audit logs, system operations.

## Competitive comparisons

- [vs Mailcow](https://vectismail.com/alternatives/mailcow/): same self-hosted philosophy, declarative config, REST API, atomic updates.
- [vs iRedMail](https://vectismail.com/alternatives/iredmail/): modern declarative surface vs the long-running OS-native open-source mail stack.
- [vs Mail-in-a-Box](https://vectismail.com/alternatives/mail-in-a-box/): one-command personal email sovereignty vs API-first multi-tenant infrastructure.
- [vs SendGrid](https://vectismail.com/alternatives/sendgrid/): self-hosted with the same API, flat $0–29/month pricing instead of per-email.
- [vs Postmark](https://vectismail.com/alternatives/postmark/): self-hosted transactional API with mailboxes included, flat pricing instead of per-email.
